goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon and reach Cerulean City

subgoals.goal_text: Leave Pewter City and enter Route 3.
Travel east across Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon.
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and descend to the basement (B1F).
Navigate through the first basement and descend to the lowest floor (B2F).
Locate and defeat the Super Nerd guarding the fossils on B2F.
Find the exit of Mt Moon and emerge onto Route 4.
Travel west on Route 4 to reach the Pokemon Center inside Mt Moon's exit area.
Heal the party at the Pokemon Center before the final stretch to Cerulean City.
Leave the Pokemon Center and return to Route 4.
Travel west across Route 4 until you enter Cerulean City.
